verdict: Organic engagement softening across all three locations this period.
narrative: Across Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision, all inbound activity this period came from Google Business Profile — a combined 385 actions including 28 calls, 239 direction requests, and 118 website clicks, with no paid spend active on any location. GBP engagement is trending down week-over-week at all three locations — most sharply at O'Hare Precision, which saw a 60% drop in the last 7 days — and organic search visibility is also retreating, with Search Console clicks falling at both Forte and O'Hare. The root cause of the visibility decline is under active investigation, and a fix is targeted for submission by August 31. Website tracking is also being repaired, so web session numbers currently under-report actual traffic.
